name: The Legend of Arcadieu
source:
The legend of Arcadieu... a mystical land filled with adventure, treasure and sexy girls.
When a young man gets trapped in this new video game, he must find a way out. The evil Queen Alexandra controls everything, but with the help of Sophie the mage and Trish the warrior, there’s still hope. Meet all kinds of sexy and funny characters and save the Kingdom of Arcadieu!

[From [url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/download/the-legend-of-arcadieu/]Nutaku[/url]]
